title: Front Office Standards for Guest Folios: Check-in and Check-out Times, Minimum Age and Incidental Holds
content:
When a Guest Folio opens at check-in, the brand standard of the hotel sets the standard check-in and check-out times, the minimum age of the registered guest, the card authorisation hold for incidentals taken per night of stay with its maximum per stay, and the cash deposit per night required from a guest who settles incidentals in cash. Times are hotel local time.

## Brand standards at check-in

| Brand | Standard check-in | Standard check-out | Minimum age of the registered guest | Incidental card hold per night of stay | Maximum incidental hold per stay | Cash incidental deposit per night |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | 15:00 | 11:00 | 18 years | $50.00 | $250.00 | $100.00 |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | 15:00 | 11:00 | 18 years | $50.00 | $300.00 | $100.00 |
| Ashbury Hotel | 15:00 | 12:00 | 18 years | $75.00 | $500.00 | $150.00 |
| Ashbury Grand | 16:00 | 12:00 | 21 years | $100.00 | $600.00 | $200.00 |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 16:00 | 11:00 | 21 years | $150.00 | $750.00 | $250.00 |
| Ashbury Reserve | 15:00 | 12:00 | 21 years | $250.00 | $1500.00 | $500.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- The incidental hold is a card authorisation taken at check-in, figured per night of stay and never above the brand's maximum incidental hold per stay.
- The cash incidental deposit applies to guests settling incidentals in cash, and is figured per night.
- The minimum age is that of the registered guest at check-in, in whole years.

## Hypothetical hold figures

| Hypothetical stay | Per-night hold | Nights | Per-night figure times nights | Brand maximum | Hold taken |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Hotel, 4 nights | $75.00 | 4 | $300.00 | $500.00 | $300.00 |
| Ashbury Hotel, 8 nights | $75.00 | 8 | $600.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 |
| Ashbury Express, 6 nights | $50.00 | 6 | $300.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 |

The nights in these rows are illustrative inputs, not standards.
